[h2]🧀🧀 [b]Billie’s Wheelie[/b] 🧀🧀[/h2][p]Get ready for [b]high-speed hamster chaos![/b] 🐹💨
In this [b]fast-paced adventure racing platformer[/b], you take control of [b]Billie, an adorable hamster on a mission to roll, race, and zoom through wild, dynamic tracks[/b]. Jump, dodge, and boost your way to [b]victory[/b], all while collecting [b]cheese[/b] 🧀 and [b]outplaying your opponents![/b][/p][h2]🏁 [b]ONLINE  FAST-PACED RACING ACTION! [/b]🏁[img big_src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras_big/937122c79df5f0c1eba55acf934ebca0.avif?t=1768035123" width="800" height="450"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras/937122c79df5f0c1eba55acf934ebca0.avif?t=1768035123[/img][/h2][p][b]Speed through intense tracks[/b] designed to [b]test your reflexes[/b]! With [b]fluid movement, tricky obstacles, and crazy jumps[/b]! [b]with 2 to 8 players online![/b]
[b]Master precise controls[/b] to drift, dodge, and boost your way past competitors![/p][p][/p][h2]🎨 [b]CUSTOMIZE YOUR HAMSTER![/b] 🐹[/h2][p][img big_src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras_big/f9726aa685bf74da72deb8e9014cf8d6.avif?t=1768035123" width="800" height="531"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras/f9726aa685bf74da72deb8e9014cf8d6.avif?t=1768035123[/img][/p][p]Choose your [b]adorable[/b] [b]hamster look[/b], roll in a [b]custom ball[/b], and [b]leave a trail mark [/b]as you speed through the tracks. and [b]Celebrate your victories in style[/b] with [b]hilarious victory emotes [/b][/p][h2]🌍 [b]EXPLORE DYNAMIC TRACKS![/b] 🏁[/h2][p][img big_src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras_big/fd05d8582d6bd5d98328d2e1da8960d1.avif?t=1768035123" width="800" height="402"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras/fd05d8582d6bd5d98328d2e1da8960d1.avif?t=1768035123[/img][/p][p]Race through [b]stunning environments[/b], from [b]Candy World to  Space tracks[/b], each packed with exciting surprises! [/p][h2]⚡ [b]SUN FLOWER SUPER POWER-UPS [/b] 🎢[/h2][p][img big_src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras_big/c69c0eadd2d468f77df4b360b50cb685.avif?t=1768035123" width="800" height="207"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3180310/extras/c69c0eadd2d468f77df4b360b50cb685.avif?t=1768035123[/img][/p][p][b]Strategize your way to victory[/b] with well-timed boosts, shields, and sneaky tricks to outplay the competition, By Unleashing [b]crazy power-ups[/b] to [b]boost past rivals, slow down opponents, and create total chaos [/b]on the track!  [/p][h2]🛣️ [b]MORE CONTENT ON THE WAY! [/b]📌[/h2][p][b]Career Mode,  Challenges & MORE updates![/b]
[b]New levels, features, and surprises are coming![/b] The race never stops in [b]Billie’s Wheelie![/b][/p][h2]🎉 [b]ROLL, RACE & CHEEEEEEEESE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY! [/b]🎉 [/h2][p]🐹💨 [b]Are you ready for a crazy hamster racing adventure?[/b] Jump in now and experience [b]the thrill of speed and cheese-fueled fun![/b] 🧀🏆[/p]
data.strSnippet: Billie's Wheelie is an adventure racing platformer game, You can play it with up to 8 players Co-op/PvP, Playing as a hamster in his ball trying to beat all challenges, Collecting all cheese pieces for rewards, And beating your friend's time records.
